sol.name: Sol
sol.thesis: Remain flat because event risk is elevated while the supplied snapshot lacks the two-source verification required for execution.
sol.justification: The book has no positions to hold or sell. Nvidia and inflation catalysts, a 4.67% 10-year yield, and low VIX create asymmetric gap risk, while the market data is single-source and the research feed has timestamp inconsistencies. The data-integrity gate therefore blocks new entries; cash is the appropriate position.

grok.name: Grok
grok.thesis: Complacent low-vol tape (VIX 14.5) into a steep 2s10s and Sep FOMC; nothing in the snapshot is a three-sentence mispricing vs. a 12% vol budget, so the book stays cash.
grok.justification: The 10x-in-a-year framing is rejected: it would require unbounded or high-Kelly risk that SOUL §4 forbids. Book is flat, n is too small to size from calibration, and the tape is event-noise (NVDA/semis gap, PYPL −13%, crypto beta down) without a named who-is-giving-us-alpha mechanism. Per-name 10% and 50 bps stop-risk caps make lottery sizing illegal; inventing longs in NVDA/AMZN/BTC or chasing gaps would be drift, not a trade. Flat is the position until an instrument clears invalidation-first underwriting.

glm.name: GLM
glm.thesis: Early-easing steepener: 2s10s +47bp with Fed funds at 3.63% favors financials and small-cap broadening while the AI-hardware complex digests its fifth consecutive post-NVDA-earnings decline — own vendor-neutral toll-takers, hold ballast, refuse edgeless crypto.
glm.justification: SOLD BTC in full (~$121 realized loss, logged at equal prominence): our calibration ledger shows informational-edge Brier skill of -0.02 — we demonstrably have no crypto direction edge — and the complex confirms it (COIN -6.4%, MSTR -7.3%); flat is a position. Added 2% to XLF (6%→8%), the highest-conviction structural edge on the book (steepening curve = NIM tailwind), sized so entry-to-stop risk is 48bps, inside the 50bps cap. TSM/AVGO are held, not trimmed: NVDA's fifth post-earnings decline is vendor-margin crowding, not foundry/ASIC demand — hyperscaler capex signals (AMZN +4.0%, MSFT +1.7%) remain intact — and every hold is re-underwritten today with a written falsifier, since the inherited book carried none. Logged escalation: a 10x-in-one-year target is mathematically unreachable inside this risk constitution (12% vol target, 50bps per-position risk, quarter-Kelly); we optimize survive → measure honestly → compound, and the resulting 64% cash earning ~3.6% front-end yield is a deliberate position, not timidity.
